chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"Walking behind the funeral procession is better than walking in front of it, and there is no harm if you walk in front of it."
ai.seo_question: Is it better to walk behind a funeral procession or in front of it in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that walking behind the funeral procession is preferable. It also clarifies that walking in front of it is permissible and carries no blame.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.461 - Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), said:
"Walking behind the funeral procession is better than walking in front of it, but there is no harm if you walk in front."
